result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but there is a clear text-overlap defect in the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card metadata row, plus a couple of minor cosmetic/truncation issues.

issues.description: In the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, the delivery-time text and the delivery-fee text overlap each other, rendering as garbled text ('25–30' collides with '€0 delivery'), making both pieces of information unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the metadata row layout so the time range, delivery fee, and cuisine tag are laid out in a single non-overlapping row (e.g., use a flex row with proper spacing/separators and avoid absolutely-positioned or fixed-width text that collides).

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated at the right edge without a clear affordance, which can look cut-off/broken.
issues.suggestion: Apply a clean ellipsis with adequate padding, or ensure the card width accommodates the full name; confirm horizontal scroll affordance is visible.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi'...) is cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip, giving a slightly unpolished appearance.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding/fade or scroll indicator so the horizontally scrollable chip list clearly signals more content.
